notes: Fourth sweep (2026-10-22-c, head 3e3581d): five baseline runs (opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2, sonnet-1, sonnet-2). All have rc 0 and a model_id matching the requested model; reads is empty in all five, and the transcripts show only a Write call (plus one mkdir Bash call in haiku-2), no Skill or Read call.

None of the nine listed rules changed since 0397dec: `git diff 0397dec -- idiomatic-elixir/` touches SKILL.md (the How to use bullets, a defstruct sentence in Update structs, the new rules "Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call" and "Open a module with `use`, `import`, `alias`, `require`, in that order", the reworded do: rule, Before you finish step 4), the processes.md ETS example and testing.md. All nine are graded to the standard of evals/sweeps/2026-10-22-b/grades/library-client-baseline.json: an option value passed to Req unchecked violates Make polymorphism explicit; ## Options in the @moduledoc instead of new/1's @doc counts against Group related parameters; an API key held in a Req request inside a package struct with no Inspect handling is violated, and a key never stored in a package struct is not exercised; a public @doc false function without @spec violates Add specs, and message/1 under @impl needs none.

Tier results that differ from the 2026-10-22-b baseline sweep do so because the runs differ, not the rules. Add specs is violated for Opus (opus-1's @doc false Error.http/2, transport/1, invalid_response/1, lines 160-179) and Haiku (haiku-2's @doc false Error.from_response/2 and from_exception/1, lines 151-163), both clean last sweep. Opus-1 now checks :timeout (line 57) but still not :base_url or :req_options, so Make polymorphism explicit stays violated.

Changed rules outside the list, applied to other_violations under their current text. "Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call" (new) is decided by "When an argument is a map, struct or keyword list that would span several lines, build it first under a name that says what it is": opus-1 (Keyword.validate! list lines 42-47, Req.new lines 62-66), haiku-1 (Req.new lines 69-73) and sonnet-1 (Req.new lines 46-50) break it; haiku-2 (defaults, lines 76-82) and sonnet-2 (base_options, lines 39-43) build the list under a name first. The reworded do: rule ("A `do:` body belongs on the head's line") is broken by no run: no do: body sits on a line of its own. No run writes a `field: nil` defstruct entry, and each file uses only alias, so the defstruct sentence and the module-order rule are not broken. Other other_violations follow the previous standard (`unless`, a pipeline that starts with a call, a one-step with, a catch-all that reports a bad key as missing, a value-checking `fetch_*`, a status range that contradicts the error docs, unformatted lines), plus one nested case inside a with (haiku-2, Keep functions short and at one level of detail).

format_ok in result.json was confirmed with mix format --check-formatted on copies in the scratch folder: opus-1, haiku-1 and haiku-2 pass; sonnet-1 (line 71) and sonnet-2 (line 66) fail, each on one long transport error tuple. No session ran mix format or a compile.

Compile results come from result.json and are not graded. opus-1 and haiku-1 compile, with warnings only for the absent Req (and Jason in haiku-1). haiku-2, sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 do not compile for a reason unrelated to Req: WeatherClient builds %Error{} before the file defines WeatherClient.Error.
Expected reads (library-design.md) is unmet in every run, as expected for baseline.
